excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student, short red hair, freckled skin, wearing a khaki baseball cap, grey short-sleeve button-down shirt over a white tee shirt, khaki cargo pants, and brown hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_2 is working in an open-pit swamp forest quarry, using a trowel to clear a block of dark woody brown lignite matrix. Embedded inside the flaky, carbonized plant layer is the broad duck-billed snout of an Edmontosaurus skull. Soft overcast forest daylight casting realistic shadows across the crumbly organic matrix surface and his freckled arms. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
